lines.text: Woe to the majestic crown of drunkards, which the Lord's strong one will smash to the ground like a hailstorm.
The crown will be trampled underfoot, and its fading flower will be like a ripe fig before the summer harvest.
On that day the LORD of Hosts will be a crown of glory to the kings of the nations.
Soldiers and prophets reel from strong drink, and all their tables are covered with vomit.
They would not listen to the offer of rest, so they will go stumbling backward and be captured.
